<br>

<script>
var mapInstance = null;
var markerInstance = null;

function mostraMappaDaIndirizzo(indirizzo, titolo) {
  var container = document.getElementById('container-mappa-leaflet');
  container.style.display = 'block';

  var url = 'https://nominatim.openstreetmap.org/search?format=json&q=' + encodeURIComponent(indirizzo);

  fetch(url)
    .then(function(response) { return response.json(); })
    .then(function(data) {
      if (data && data.length > 0) {
        var lat = parseFloat(data[0].lat);
        var lon = parseFloat(data[0].lon);

        if (!mapInstance) {
          mapInstance = L.map('map').setView([lat, lon], 13);
          
          L.tileLayer('https://tile.openstreetmap.org/{z}/{x}/{y}.png', {
            maxZoom: 19,
            attribution: '&copy; <a href="http://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright">OpenStreetMap</a>'
          }).addTo(mapInstance);

          markerInstance = L.marker([lat, lon]).addTo(mapInstance);
        } else {
          mapInstance.flyTo([lat, lon], 13, { duration: 1.5 });
          markerInstance.setLatLng([lat, lon]);
        }

        markerInstance.bindPopup('<b>' + titolo + '</b><br>' + indirizzo).openPopup();

        container.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });

        setTimeout(function() {
          mapInstance.invalidateSize();
        }, 300);
      } else {
        alert('Indirizzo non trovato: ' + indirizzo);
      }
    })
    .catch(function(error) {
      console.error('Errore durante la geocodifica:', error);
    });
}
</script>
